discovery_notes: Follow-up 4 of B010 (WDW LE 2018). 30 standard WebSearch queries, all search_snippet; blocked_domains passed or allowed_domains narrowed. All claims from Disney Pins Blog. Resellers (yourwdwstore, distradingpins4u, ecrater) and a forum auction seen, not used. New: Star Wars vehicle #10 Death Star and #13 Poe's X-Wing; May the 4th Millennium Falcon; Chewie is my Copilot; Cinco de Mayo/Nurses Day/Mother's Day 2018; Sam Eagle Independence Day; TSL AP Open (OE, held for variant check); Star Wars Half Marathon 2018 race/medal pins (held per runDisney list decision). Corroboration: Lattes Jiminy LE 3,000 $16.99 Feb 8. No holds released. No prompt-injection seen.
